Applications & industries

Where our resistors work — and the industries that rely on them.

Applications

01

Neutral grounding

The neutral of a transformer or generator is connected to ground through a Neutral Grounding Resistor (NGR) to limit phase-to-ground fault currents in case of a line-to-ground fault.

Neutral grounding resistors
02

Dynamic braking

Dynamic braking resistors are used for rheostatic braking of electric motors. The excess kinetic energy from braking or slowing down the load is dissipated on the resistors.

Dynamic braking resistors
03

Loadbanks

Loadbanks load gensets or other power sources so they can be tested to ensure they deliver their rated power in actual loading conditions.

Loadbanks
04

Motor starting

Start resistors are used with switch-starters or contactors for starting and speed regulating of AC slipring motors as well as DC motors — where electronic drives are inadequate due to severe operating conditions.

Motor starting resistors
